description: Check up to 20 BOM lines for lifecycle, stock against quantity, observed single-distributor sourcing, datasheet status and stale/missing prices. Accepts MPNs or LCSC numbers; duplicate MPN quantities are aggregated. Uses exact identities, catalogue snapshots and available distributor details. Unknown remains unknown; single_source does not prove only one supplier exists. Compact columns/rows by default; verbose returns objects. No extraction.
name: check_bom
title: Check BOM
